video_title: Iman Shumpert's MESSAGE to Jalen Brunson 🗣️ YOU'RE THE NEW MODEL! | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's excessive dribbling and need for offensive adjustments
quotes.excerpt: How do you do things to get the ball out of Jalen Brunson's hands?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: We did a breakdown the other day where there are multiple possessions where Jalen Brunson aired out the gym. 18, 19, 20 dribbles in a possession where nobody else on the court even touched the ball. How do you do things to get the ball out of Jalen Brunson's hands?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I would go back to the person that is guarding that Victor Wembanyama is guarding. Have him initiate your offense. At the beginning, he was guarding Josh Hart. So I think Josh Hart maybe bringing the ball up, getting Jalen Brunson off the ball, and playing through Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's evolution into a big-bodied primary offensive initiator
quotes.excerpt: You big-body Brunson now. We can't revert back.
quotes.quote: It is like the new model car coming out. We paid for the new model. We can't revert back to the 2024. That is 2024, Brunson. You big-body Brunson now. We can't revert back. And I say that because right now, he is trying to lead with the dribble. If you want to have the ball, that is fine, 21 action. All you have to do is force the rest of the San Antonio Spurs to have to guard and use their principles.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of Knicks' off-ball movement and floor spacing
quotes.excerpt: If the floor doesn't spread out, if we can't get guys diving, we can't get flare screens.
quotes.quote: If the floor doesn't spread out, if we can't get guys diving, we can't get flare screens, we are not going to get any of that. When you have Josh Hart up there holding the ball into a triple threat, his vision tells the story. If I look over there, your principles have to kick in. If I look over there, your principles have to kick in. Now we have movement. Landry Shamet has been a great, brilliant bright spot for them. He has been able to defend and knock down threes, but these guys can't get off if the floor doesn't spread out.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' offensive movement and Karl-Anthony Towns' role as a facilitator
quotes.excerpt: The best basketball for this team is its movement.
quotes.quote: The best basketball for this team is its movement. But Karl-Anthony Towns did not exactly put himself in a position to come and be that facilitator. As we are watching this film, he is busy dancing and playing around with Kelden Johnson. And I am not saying that that is an easy assignment. I don't want to take away from the physicality of it. But what we saw very clearly in that offense is him established position at the top of the key to be that facilitator. And then Jalen Brunson can run off the ball and set screens and find soft spots in the defense.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' need to play with physicality and purpose
quotes.excerpt: You can't get lost in just trying to bang and dance with Kelden Johnson.
quotes.quote: If you are Karl-Anthony Towns, you can't get lost in just trying to bang and dance with Kelden Johnson. You have to take him to a place where you can turn and make a move. There is no way Kelden Johnson should be able to guard a dude who is 7 feet tall, 250 pounds.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' foul trouble and playmaking impact
quotes.excerpt: If Karl-Anthony Towns has four or more assists, the Knicks are 13 and one.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns tends to foul too much. He doesn't know how to be physical without being overly physical, doing it in front of the refs and drawing a foul. The numbers say this, guys: over the last two postseasons, if Karl-Anthony Towns has four or more assists, the Knicks are 13 and one. That just means you have a primary playmaker in addition to Jalen Brunson. Brunson is going to get his anyway. You just have to find the way to get everybody else involved.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' need to establish himself as a physical force
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns has to establish more for himself.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns has to establish more for himself. You can't get caught up in that. Karl-Anthony Towns, you have to realize that as a guy that was a guard, if they ever threw me on a big, the reason I am doing all of this, you don't realize it, but I am taking your clock away. We sitting here wrestling, let's arm wrestle, do that. You playing in my hands because really, if you just walk down here and become large all at one time, I like when guys just walk down their face, they just walk you down, walk you down, we just going to let you lean on me, do whatever.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' lack of fourth-quarter scoring in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns has not scored a single point in the fourth quarters of any of the games.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns, who has obviously generally played very well, has not scored a single point in the fourth quarters of any of the games. He is only taken six shots and has not attempted a single free throw. More importantly, he is zero for six field goals.
